title: Kev Hloov Pauv Ntawm Tib Neeg Lub Xeev Siab Thiab Kev Cuam Tshuam Rau Kev Tsim Kho Lub Zej Zog
english: Changes in Human Psychological States and Their Impact on Community Development
blurb: Human thought and behavior arise from both inborn traits and life experience, raising major questions about individual choice and community responsibility.

paragraphs.hmong: Tib neeg lub xeev siab yog ib yam uas nyuaj kawg nkaus rau cov kws tshawb fawb los nkag siab kom tiav, vim nws muaj ntau txheej ntau theem uas sib cuam tshuam loj heev.
paragraphs.english: Human psychological state is something that is extremely difficult for researchers to fully understand, because it has many layers and levels that are deeply interconnected.

paragraphs.hmong: Txij li thaum cov kws tshawb fawb pib tshawb txog lub hlwb tib neeg nyob rau xyoo pua 19, lawv tau pom tias tib neeg txoj kev xav, kev coj cwj pwm, thiab kev tawm tswv yim tsis yog los ntawm ib qho xwb.
paragraphs.english: Ever since researchers began studying the human brain in the 19th century, they have observed that human thought, behavior, and independent reasoning do not come from only one source.

paragraphs.hmong: Nws yog qhov tshwm sim los ntawm kev sib xyaw ntawm yam uas yug los nrog thiab yam uas ib tus neeg tau ntsib thiab kawm los hauv nws lub neej.
paragraphs.english: They are the result of a combination of what a person is born with and what that person encounters and learns during life.

paragraphs.hmong: Qhov no tau ua rau cov kws txawj ntse sib cav hnyav tias puas yog ib tus neeg txoj kev xav thiab nws txoj kev coj ua yog yam uas nws xaiv tau, lossis puas yog nws raug txiav txim los ntawm yam uas nws tsis muaj peev xwm tswj tau.
paragraphs.english: This has led intellectuals to debate intensely whether a person’s thoughts and behavior are things they can choose, or whether they are determined by things beyond their ability to control.

paragraphs.hmong: Qhov uas ua rau qhov no tseem ceeb tshaj yog thaum peb los xam txog seb kev hloov pauv lub xeev siab cuam tshuam li cas rau kev tsim kho lub zej zog.
paragraphs.english: What makes this especially important is considering how changes in psychological state affect the development of communities.

paragraphs.hmong: Yog tias tib neeg txoj kev coj ua tuaj yeem hloov tau los ntawm kev kawm thiab kev sib cuam tshuam nrog ib puag ncig, ces lub zej zog muaj lub luag haujlwm loj heev los tsim ib lub ib puag ncig uas txhawb nqa txoj kev xav zoo thiab kev coj cwj pwm muaj txiaj ntsig.
paragraphs.english: If human behavior can be changed through learning and interaction with the environment, then the community has a great responsibility to create an environment that nurtures positive thinking and beneficial behavior.

paragraphs.hmong: Tiamsis, yog tias feem ntau ntawm tib neeg txoj kev coj ua yog raug txiav txim los ntawm yam nws yug los nrog, ces cov thawj coj hauv zej zog yuav tsum rov xav dua txog lawv txoj hau kev los pab cov neeg uas raug kev nyuaj siab los ntawm lawv tus kheej lub xeev siab.
paragraphs.english: However, if most human behavior is determined by what a person is born with, then community leaders must reconsider their approach to helping people who suffer difficulties because of their own psychological state.

paragraphs.hmong: Txoj lus nug no tseem nyob qhib rau kev tshawb fawb ntxiv, tiamsis nws twb tau hloov pauv txoj kev uas peb saib thiab nkag siab txog tib neeg lub neej thiab lub zej zog ib nkag lawm.
paragraphs.english: This question remains open for further research, but it has already changed the way we view and understand human life and society as a whole.

questions.prompt: Vim li cas tib neeg lub xeev siab thiaj nyuaj rau cov kws tshawb fawb nkag siab? — Why is human psychological state difficult for researchers to understand?
options: It has many deeply interconnected layers and levels
It comes from only one simple source
It never changes during life
It only concerns physical strength
questions.answer: It has many deeply interconnected layers and levels
questions.because: Paragraph 1 — “Nws muaj ntau txheej ntau theem uas sib cuam tshuam loj heev.”

questions.prompt: Cov kws tshawb fawb tau pib tshawb txog lub hlwb tib neeg thaum twg? — When did researchers begin studying the human brain?
options: In the 19th century
In the 15th century
In the 21st century
Only after the year 2000
questions.because: Paragraph 1 — “Cov kws tshawb fawb pib tshawb txog lub hlwb tib neeg nyob rau xyoo pua 19.”

questions.prompt: Tib neeg txoj kev xav thiab kev coj cwj pwm yog los ntawm dab tsi? — What do human thought and behavior result from?
options: A combination of inborn traits and life experiences
Only what a person is born with
Only one person’s opinions
Only the place where someone lives
questions.answer: A combination of inborn traits and life experiences
questions.because: Paragraph 2 — “Kev sib xyaw ntawm yam uas yug los nrog thiab yam uas ib tus neeg tau ntsib thiab kawm los hauv nws lub neej.”

questions.prompt: Cov kws txawj ntse sib cav txog dab tsi? — What do intellectuals debate about?
options: Whether people choose their behavior or whether it is determined beyond their control
Whether hospitals should be built in forests
Whether people should stop learning
Whether communities should have leaders
questions.answer: Whether people choose their behavior or whether it is determined beyond their control
questions.because: Paragraph 2 — “Puas yog ib tus neeg txoj kev xav thiab nws txoj kev coj ua yog yam uas nws xaiv tau, lossis puas yog nws raug txiav txim los ntawm yam uas nws tsis muaj peev xwm tswj tau.”

questions.prompt: Yog tib neeg txoj kev coj ua hloov tau los ntawm kev kawm, lub zej zog muaj lub luag haujlwm dab tsi? — If behavior can change through learning, what responsibility does the community have?
options: To create an environment that supports positive thinking and beneficial behavior
To stop people from learning
To ignore people who need help
To decide every person’s thoughts for them
questions.answer: To create an environment that supports positive thinking and beneficial behavior
questions.because: Paragraph 3 — “Lub zej zog muaj lub luag haujlwm loj heev los tsim ib lub ib puag ncig uas txhawb nqa txoj kev xav zoo thiab kev coj cwj pwm muaj txiaj ntsig.”

questions.prompt: Yog kev coj cwj pwm feem ntau raug txiav txim los ntawm yam yug los nrog, cov thawj coj yuav tsum ua dab tsi? — If behavior is mostly determined by inborn traits, what should community leaders do?
options: Reconsider their approach to helping people who are struggling
Stop supporting the community
Prevent people from receiving help
Ignore psychological difficulties
questions.answer: Reconsider their approach to helping people who are struggling
questions.because: Paragraph 4 — “Cov thawj coj hauv zej zog yuav tsum rov xav dua txog lawv txoj hau kev los pab cov neeg uas raug kev nyuaj siab.”

questions.prompt: Txoj lus nug txog kev xaiv thiab yam yug los nrog puas tau muaj lus teb kawg lawm? — Has the question about choice and inborn traits been fully answered?
options: No, it remains open for further research
Yes, it was fully answered in the 19th century
Yes, only community leaders can answer it
No, because human behavior does not exist
questions.answer: No, it remains open for further research
questions.because: Paragraph 4 — “Txoj lus nug no tseem nyob qhib rau kev tshawb fawb ntxiv.”
